lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A matrix of high-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately five horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank. Inter-centroid spacing is significantly greater in the mid-body than in the anterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal spot clusters, forming a faint, irregular grid-like structure posterior to the branchial region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light (dorsal edge) to shadow (ventral edge).

other_distinctive_markers: A transition from high-density, small-scale pixel clusters in the cephalic region to larger, discrete circular maculae on the lateral trunk is observed.
